TableS1.caption: Table S1. Indicator weights of the DSI with and without NPV under alternative weighting configurations.

TableS2a.caption: Table S2a. Sensitivity of 2001–2021 DSI trend classes to the weighting configuration.
notes: Trends are OLS slopes of the non-growing-season DSI classified at a nominal two-sided P < 0.05; recovery and degradation denote significant DSI decreases and increases. Percentages are area-weighted by cos(latitude), as in Fig. 7, and share the same denominator across configurations. Class agreement is the area fraction assigned to the same trend class as in the main configuration.

TableS2b.caption: Table S2b. Sensitivity of the paired with- and without-NPV contrast to the weighting configuration, 2004–2019.
notes: ΔDSI = DSI with NPV − DSI without NPV, averaged over the 16 seasons (Eq. 22). Mean ΔDSI and area fractions use WGS84 ellipsoidal pixel-area weights; denominators are the total paired area (454,755 pixels valid in all 16 seasons). Trend-class change includes any transition among significant degradation, no significant trend and significant recovery; direct reversal is the subset switching between significant degradation and significant recovery.
